failure.title: Trace normalization obscured the memo
failure.description: PRISM grouped 52 tentative, instrumentation-affected warnings. Three verified cluster members stored a retrieval payload instead of the generated memo; inspecting the trace localized the span-normalization bug. These are observability failures, not 52 hallucinations.

methodology: 50 fixed inputs per version (25 normal + 25 adversarial), independently checked with the application JSON schema. Baseline had two true contract failures; v2 delivered 50 live memos using 51 provider calls, including one retained invalid→valid repair. Routing slug stayed nicrron/auto; underlying models may vary. The external PRISM judge did not calibrate, so no external score or factual-grounding improvement is claimed.
